apps.localizedDescription: OpenGothic for iPhone and iPad with MetalFX Spatial and automatic Lanczos fallback, 512 x 512 mobile shadow maps, off-screen NPC animation optimization, touch controls and physical-controller support. Requires legally owned Gothic II: Night of the Raven game data; no game assets are included.
